name: Xylophone
summary: Xylophone with coloured bars on a wooden frame and two mallets; anim play strikes the bars in turn. For music scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the frame feet rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 760 px wide and 560 px tall (table-top size: about 0.6 next to a person)

params.name: anim
params.note: play = the mallets strike the bars in turn, left to right and back

author: krakujs
